scientific_limitations: The discotope object and its support representation are prior mathematics; originality is limited to the all-dimensional exact radii, phases, sharp Euclidean roundness and equality. Classical equivalences may remain; no independent audit. Only strictly positive orthotope side lengths and probability-normalized Radon operator are covered.
title: Exact water-filling radii and sharp spherical roundness of Radon mean-section bodies of orthotopes
